description: This file declares external functions related to parameter retrieval and instance management within the Cosa (Common Object System Architecture) utilities, specifically for bus utilities in the TR-181 middle layer. It provides function prototypes for getting parameter values of various types and for retrieving instance numbers based on object names and indices.

methods.name: CosaGetParamValueUlong
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long parameter value given its name.

methods.name: CosaGetParamValueString
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value given its name, buffer, and size.

methods.name: CosaGetParamValueBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value given its name.

methods.name: CosaGetInstanceNumberByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the instance number of an object given its name and index.
